notes.title: Power-ups update
notes.notes:
The new epic feature has been added to Cube Smash: Power-ups!

In the first update  following power-ups are coming:
[olist] 
1. Shield; When you shot the "shield" power-up, you gain an energy shield around you preventing all the cubes to attack you.
2. Heal; When you hit the "heal" power-up it will "cure" one of your wrongs and you gain more chance to smash all the other cubes.
3. Colorless ammo; When you smash this "ammo" power-up you can shoot all the cubes regardless of their color.
[/olist]
These first few power-ups are coming in this update, but there will be many others included in the future updates.
